$Comment: The full moon, the game's own: live while the default world's moon is in phase 0 (full) or 1 (the
night after), the way a world spawn's MoonPhaseRange reads it. The moon turns over at midday and
a cycle is five game days, so it is live two game days in five: on the game's default day length,
about an hour and a half of every four real hours. The file name is the event id.
It is a condition, not a run: it has no dates, no FirstYear, no attendance and no Almanac page,
and nothing in the pack names it in a Season leaf directly. Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Moon (a
full moon outside Hallow's Eve) is built on it, so an October full moon changes nothing. It has
no Herald; Restless Moon carries the banner. Write World to follow another world's moon instead
A server owner switches it off in mods/ziggfreedcommon/calendar.json, which takes the
Gravekeeper's full moon visits and the Hallowed's full moon favor with it.
/zigcalendar status Seasons_Of_Orbis_Full_Moon shows what the server reads;
/zigcalendar force on Seasons_Of_Orbis_Full_Moon raises it until
